title: 第3章 北境乱起第4章 诺水河族
slug: 寻仙启示录第204章有区别吗
content_zh:
照左丘牧的话所讲，故事的最后也是他终身难忘的，因为那是他走过这辈子最艰难的一段路，比刀山火海还难，而左丘其他族人更是互相搀扶，一步当三步走，在各种灵兽奇异的目光中，左丘族人足足用了四五个时辰才慢慢走出左丘山...
“落轿，迎左丘小主！”
一声高呼，打破了忙碌的众人，叫醒了左丘辰，停止了左丘牧的回忆，也开启了成人礼的序幕。
此刻左丘牧身旁站着一位雍容华贵的美妇人，此人名叫武都娴，是武都族大长老之女，同时也是左丘牧的妻子。
“孩儿见过父亲母亲。”
左丘辰走到两人身前就要行跪拜之礼，但被一只大手拉住。
“这些俗礼就免了，看到你我们就很高兴了，哈哈...”
左丘牧大笑道，身旁美妇也是微笑点头，虽说左丘辰身无灵力，但是长相好，又聪明懂事，两人对其也是十分溺爱。
“时辰已到，那就开始吧！”
“咚咚咚...”
红布包裹的锤头使劲敲打着虎座鸟架鼓，所有的宾客带着微笑和贺礼，一队队人进入族中。
“恭喜了啊左丘族长，二公子今天就成年了。”
“老牧，祝贺祝贺。”
“不错啊左丘族长，你大儿子出类拔萃，二儿子更是生得如玉。”
左丘辰一直面带笑意，凡是道贺过的人，左丘辰也是一一鞠躬还礼，虽然明知道这些人来是给左丘族，或者是给左丘牧面子，但无论如何，这一切都让左丘辰十分感动。
“小哥哥，别来无恙啊。”
脆耳的声音响起，左丘辰左肩上已经多了一只玉手，抬头看去，一位少女调皮的看着自己。
“欢迎武都兰儿，见过武都王！”左丘辰也是很礼貌对着少女旁边之人行礼。
“小妮子，越来越调皮了，武都王，生得个好生可爱的女儿啊。”
左丘牧更是对着武都王调侃，而后者也是微笑点头回应。

不多时，宾客到齐，作为主办方左丘牧看着满堂高坐也是满意，随举起酒杯大喝道：“吾儿左丘辰今日已然十六，按照九州大陆规矩，他已经算是个成年人了。”
“今天感谢各位，武都族，窦娴族，还有尤利和北河的部族，族中的各位族老叔伯些，今天老夫高兴啊，来，辰儿泽儿，陪各位族长喝几杯。”
看着左丘牧如此高兴，左丘辰心中更是感动，和左丘泽对视一眼，两人也是上前敬酒。
九州大陆对于成年礼一般都是无比重视的，因为这一天代表你成年，同时家族中人也会根据你的修为，表现出的天赋来决定你以后的路，或者是把家业传承给你，而左丘泽就是上个月成人礼时候被定为下任左丘王的接班人。
但左丘辰是个例外，众人都知道他的情况，故此不会有什么展示，也不会赐予什么灵术，左丘牧索性就大摆筵席，大家吃吃喝喝就行，而这也是没有办法的办法...
宴会持续很久，直至深夜，灯火通明的左丘族内，众人面容皆是几分担忧与无奈。
“武都王，说说吧，看你一天没怎么笑过，现在家事处理完了，该说说正事了。”
屋内左丘牧看着对面坐着的宽袍男子说道，同时窦娴娘，武都娴，尤利和北河族两位主事人目光也是放到了武都王身上。
“天道已死，青天当立，一统九州，唯我青圣，此言想必大家都听过了吧？”
“夫子登道山已有五十载，如今九州大陆大乱已起，我们虽然五族结盟，但在这巨大的漩涡中很难生存，诸位得做好打算啊。”
武都王说完后长叹一口气，众人心中也是一紧，五族联盟虽然在这凉州站稳了脚跟，但是青圣之乱就在北境，覆巢之下安有完卵？凉州其他族早已被侵蚀，这才短短几个月，已经爆发了数次大战，想必往后的日子更加难过。
“老牧，你身为这一代左丘王，也是北境十王之后，你是怎么打算的？”
面对询问，左丘牧起身看着远方，对啊，北境十王当年在魔族之乱挺身而出，不畏生死守住了北境，如今虽然十王落寞，甚至被世人嘲笑北境无圣，但那又如何，死？何惧之！
“明日我会安排辰儿带着龙纹印章前往北安城，看能不能在北宣学院找到解决他无法入灵的办法。”
“我们几族的青年才俊外送一些到其他州亲属家，留下的加强修炼，另外雪国，和北海请大祭司去商讨青圣之乱，我们这些老家伙去拜访凉州其他族，能拉一个入伙是一个，为暴风来临前做好准备。”
听完左丘牧的分析，几人也是点头，总比什么都不做等死强吧，后续几人又商讨了许多事情，直至大雪纷飞又是一个深夜...
content_en:
According to Zuoqiu Mu's words, the end of the story was something he would never forget, because it was the most difficult journey he had ever walked in his life, more difficult than a mountain of knives and a sea of fire. The other members of the Zuoqiu tribe even supported each other, walking one step at a time. Under the strange eyes of various spiritual beasts, it took the Zuoqiu tribesmen four or five hours to slowly walk out of Zuoqiu Mountain...
"Get off the sedan chair and welcome the young master Zuoqiu!"
A loud shout broke through the busy crowd, woke Zuo Qiuchen, stopped Zuo Qiu Mu's memories, and started the coming of age ceremony.
At this moment, there was a graceful and beautiful woman standing next to Zuo Qiu Mu. This person's name was Wu Duxian. She was the daughter of the great elder of the Wudu tribe and Zuo Qiu Mu's wife.
"The child has seen his father and mother."
Zuo Qiuchen walked up to the two of them and was about to kneel down, but was held back by a big hand.
"There is no need for these common etiquette. We are very happy to see you, haha..."
Zuo Qiu Mu laughed and said, and the beautiful woman beside him also smiled and nodded. Although Zuo Qiuchen had no spiritual power, he was good-looking, smart and sensible, and the two of them doted on him very much.
"The time has come, let's get started!"
"Dong dong dong..."
The hammer head wrapped in red cloth beat the tiger bird drum vigorously, and all the guests entered the clan group by group with smiles and congratulatory gifts.
"Congratulations, Chief Zuoqiu, the second young master will be an adult today."
"Old Mu, congratulations."
"That's right, Chief Zuoqiu, your eldest son is outstanding, and your second son is as good as jade."
Zuo Qiuchen always had a smile on his face, and he bowed back to everyone who congratulated him. Although he knew clearly that these people came to give Zuoqiu tribe or Zuoqiu Mu face, Zuo Qiuchen was very touched by all of this anyway.
"Little brother, you are fine."
A crisp voice sounded, and Zuo Qiuchen had a jade hand on his left shoulder. He looked up and saw a girl looking at him mischievously.
"Welcome Wudu Lan'er, I've met King Wudu!" Zuo Qiuchen also politely saluted the person next to the girl.
"Xiao Nizi, you are getting more and more naughty. King Wudu, you have such a lovely daughter."
Zuo Qiu Mu even teased King Wudu, who also smiled and nodded in response.
Not long after, the guests arrived. Zuo Qiu Mu, the organizer, was satisfied with the crowd of people sitting in the hall. He then raised his glass and shouted: "My son Zuo Qiuchen is sixteen today. According to the rules of Kyushu Continent, he is already considered an adult."
"Thank you all today, the Wudu clan, the Dou Xian clan, and the tribes of Yuli and Beihe. I am very happy today. Come, Chen'erze'er, have a few drinks with the clan leaders."
Seeing Zuo Qiu Mu so happy, Zuo Qiuchen was even more moved. He looked at Zuo Qiu Ze and the two of them also stepped forward to propose a toast.
Kyushu Continent generally attaches great importance to coming-of-age ceremonies, because this day represents your coming of age. At the same time, family members will also decide your future path based on your cultivation and talents, or pass on the family business to you. Zuo Qiu Ze was designated as the successor of the next King Zuoqiu during the coming-of-age ceremony last month.
But Zuo Qiuchen is an exception. Everyone knows his situation, so there will be no show or any spiritual skills. Zuo Qiu Mu will simply hold a feast for everyone to eat and drink. There is no other way...
The banquet lasted for a long time until late at night. Everyone in the brightly lit Zuoqiu clan looked worried and helpless.
"King Wudu, let's talk about it. I see you haven't smiled much all day. Now that the family affairs are taken care of, it's time to talk about business."
In the room, Zuo Qiu Mu looked at the man in broad robes sitting across from him and said. At the same time, Dou Xanniang, Wu Duxian, Yuli and the Beihe tribe also focused their attention on King Wudu.
"The way of heaven is dead, the blue sky will stand, and the nine states will be unified. Only I, the Qingsheng, must have heard this, right?"
"The Master has been climbing Tao Mountain for fifty years.Nowadays, chaos has broken out in the Nine Provinces Continent. Although the five races have formed an alliance, it will be difficult to survive in this huge whirlpool. You must make plans. "
After King Wudu finished speaking, he let out a long sigh, and everyone's hearts tightened. Although the Alliance of Five Tribes had established a firm foothold in Liangzhou, the Qingsheng Rebellion was in the north. Are there any intact eggs under the overthrow of the nest? The other tribes in Liangzhou have already been eroded. In just a few months, several wars have broken out. The days to come will surely be even more difficult.
"Old Mu, as the king of Zuoqiu of this generation and the queen of the ten kings in the north, what are your plans? "
Facing the inquiry, Zuo Qiu Mu stood up and looked into the distance. Yes, the ten kings of the North stood up during the demon rebellion and defended the North without fear of life and death. Now, although the ten kings are lonely and even ridiculed by the world for being unsage in the North, so what, death? Why fear it!
"Tomorrow I will arrange for Chen'er to go to Bei'an City with the dragon seal to see if we can find a solution to his inability to enter the spirit at Beixuan College. "
"Some of the young talents from our tribes are sent to the homes of relatives in other states, and the remaining ones are left behind to strengthen their cultivation. In addition, Snow Country, and Beihai invite high priests to discuss the Qingsheng Rebellion. We old guys will visit other tribes in Liangzhou. If we can get one to join the group, we will prepare for the storm. "
After listening to Zuo Qiu Mu's analysis, a few people nodded. It would be better than doing nothing and waiting to die. They then discussed many things until it was snowing and late at night...
